definition: how two amounts compare to each other
description: A rooftop party at dusk under strings of light bulbs. A grinning young man in a patterned shirt pours water from a big clear bottle held high into a glass jug of orange juice, while a friend beside him pours in juice from a carton, so the jug ends up about half juice and half water. He then lowers the bottle and laughs. Other friends laugh, gasp and grab each other's arms. On the folding table are lemons, a bowl of ice, plastic cups, a cool box and a glass of juice.

taps.target: the man in the patterned shirt
